mechanism_narrative: A increase in housing starts signals a strong demand for housing, which in turn drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4% signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, which in turn drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply chain, which in turn drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales and a decrease in unemployment rate signal a strong demand and labor market, which in turn drive economic growth and produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index signal an easing monetary cycle and high inflation, which in turn drive economic growth and produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate and an increase in payroll employment signal a strong labor market, which in turn drives economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and high payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP and an increase in housing starts signal a weak demand and strong housing market, which in turn drive economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in recovery periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
